rules.rule: Link vertical spacing = lesser of 16 x vertical bar dia and 2 x wall thickness. Any vertical compression bar not enclosed by a link must be within 200 mm of a restrained bar. Horizontal link spacing <= 2 x wall thickness.

rules.rule: Two mats (one per face) fixed as orthogonal layers. Face letters: N = near face, F = far face. Identical bars on different faces are itemised (marked) separately.

rules.rule: Isolated openings smaller than reinforcement pitch need not be trimmed.

rules.rule: Opening affecting structural integrity: consider diagonal bars at corners for crack control.

rules.rule: Opening not affecting structural integrity: trim with bars one size larger than surrounding wall bars; min wall thickness increased to 175 mm; U-bars same size as horizontal bars placed round the opening enclosing the trimmers (MW4).

figure.then: trimmers = next size up; U-bars = horizontal bar size around trimmers; t >= 175

rules.rule: MW4 details: trimmer dia one size larger than vertical bars; walls < 250 thick: single trimmer of equivalent area above/below hole; walls <= 200 thick: single trimmer each side of hole; tension anchorage length beyond trimmers; compression lap unless specified; tension lap at U-bars.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: MW2 corner: tension lap; 2 bars inside the loop for wall t <= 300, 4 bars for t > 300; U-bars same size and pitch as horizontal bars; main bar cover/size/pitch from MW1.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Half landings: starter bars may be inserted in walls; mechanical shear dowels and couplers are alternatives to half joints (avoid nibs).

rules.rule: Vertical bars rest on kicker; U-bars at top; L-bars at bottom; projection above floor = compression lap + kicker height; foundation level: compression lap + 150 (level tolerance); kicker 75 (150 below ground); min 450 horizontal leg of L-bar label shown.
